svg.title: A rational function split into two simple fractions
svg.desc: Graph on x from −7 to 5 of y = (x + 7)/((x − 1)(x + 3)), drawn solid violet, with dashed vertical asymptotes at x = 1 and x = −3. Two dashed curves show its pieces: y = 2/(x − 1) in blue, with its asymptote at x = 1, and y = −1/(x + 3) in vermillion, with its asymptote at x = −3. At every x the violet curve is the sum of the blue and vermillion curves, so the integral of the violet function is 2 ln|x − 1| − ln|x + 3| + C.

text.tspan: One fraction is the sum of two simple ones: (x + 7)/((x − 1)(x + 3)) = 2/(x − 1) − 1/(x + 3)
Each simple fraction integrates to a natural log: 2 ln|x − 1| − ln|x + 3| + C.
